title: Freshers Orientation & Induction Programme
description: Campus orientation, library tour, mentor allotment, and academic regulations briefing.

title: Commencement of Regular Academic Classes
description: Formal start of theory lectures and laboratory sessions as per semester timetables.

title: Last Date for Odd Semester Course Registration & Elective Choice
description: Students must finalize core elective selections through the student desk.

title: Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA-1) Theory Exams
description: Mid-term written tests covering Units 1 & 2 of all registered courses.

title: Dussehra & Diwali Autumn Break
description: University closed for festive autumn break. Hostel messes operate on holiday timings.

title: Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA-2) & Lab Evaluations
description: Comprehensive evaluation covering Units 3, 4 & practical viva voce.

title: Last Instructional Day (Odd Semester)
description: Dissemination of final aggregate attendance percentages and issuance of examination admit cards.

title: End-Semester Practical & Viva Voce Examinations
description: External laboratory evaluations with university-appointed external examiners.

title: End-Semester University Theory Examinations
description: Official statutory theory exams conducted by the Controller of Examinations.

title: Winter Vacation & Semester Break
description: Winter vacation for undergraduate and postgraduate cohorts.

title: Commencement of Even Semester 2027
description: Reopening of campus for Even Semester theory lectures.

title: Annual National Cultural Fest 'Milan 2027'
description: Flagship university 4-day cultural extravaganza with musical concerts, fashion, and art.
